title: Conformal Cyclic Cosmology (Penrose)
efc_relevance: Universe as infinite sequence of aeons joined by conformal rescaling at cosmological horizons. Radically different ontology from EFC — CCC is pre-big-bang cyclic, EFC is single-aeon with internal regime transitions. CCC predicts specific CMB anomalies (Hawking points); EFC predicts μ–Σ deviations. Not directly comparable probe-by-probe but both challenge standard ΛCDM initial-conditions narrative.
ledger_action: Logged as alternative cosmology with orthogonal test surface. Reference only; no head-to-head foreseen.
